data.rationale: The proposal has the right goal, order, and parameters (package A and B), but it is vague on specifics: it doesn't say to open the exact search result, to use the PyPI search box, to switch to the Notes tab and click "New note", or to press Enter, and it condenses the second package into "repeat", so an automation would need to guess several details.
